purpose: Small navigation and resume record; not a repository inventory, execution engine, authorization, or passing-check claim.

startup: read this state only when selecting or resuming a task
read_policy.budget_kind: Soft limit on initial task-specific reads, excluding startup records; never skip a safety-critical dependency to satisfy it.
expand_only_for: a named import or caller needed for the change
avoid: whole-tree listing when a task entry point is known
reading every task entry point upfront
re-reading unchanged content already available in the current turn
repeated status polling without a concrete reason
read_policy.invalidate: A changed path invalidates its cached conclusions and affected dependencies, not the entire repository. Re-read touched files before editing; stop on unexpected concurrent changes.
read_policy.research_rule: For an all-documents request, finish all inventory pages and document ranges, but checkpoint each bounded batch instead of rereading completed ranges.

solana-transactions.evidence_status: Navigation hints from prior handoff; current behavior and checks must be verified only when this task resumes.

solana-program.evidence_status: Read program and direct dependencies only for a program task; do not repeat program review for documentation work.

unfinished_work.next_action: Prior library inventory remains incomplete and is not resumed here. docs/launchpad-build-spec.md now exists for this approved AMM milestone; do not infer full library review.
unfinished_work.cursor_rules: Store actual tool-returned offsets and hashes only. Pass the prior hash on continuation; restart the affected document on hash mismatch. next_offset=null establishes completion only after all preceding ranges were reviewed. No historical hashes or offsets have been invented. Persist progress after each bounded batch and before handoff.
